fragments.text: Good morning. Welcome to the Early Learning Childcare Centre. How may I help you?

sentences.translation: 早晨好。欢迎来到儿童早教护理中心。我要怎样帮助您？

fragments.text: Hi. I spoke to you last week about
my daughter for next year.

sentences.speaker: Carol
sentences.translation: 你好，我上周跟你谈过关于我女儿明年入学的事情。

fragments.text: Oh, yes. I'll just get
from you. So, you're her mother? That's right.

sentences.speaker: Staff
sentences.translation: 哦，是的。我需要你提供些详细信息。所以你是她的妈妈？是的。

fragments.text: And, can I have your name? It's Carol, Carol Smith.

sentences.speaker: Staff
sentences.translation: 请问你的名字？是卡罗，卡罗·史密斯。

fragments.text: And your daughter's name? It's Kate.

sentences.speaker: Staff
sentences.translation: 那你女儿的名字呢？是凯特。

at the centre and we cater for children from

fragments.text: She's three now but she turns four next month.

sentences.speaker: Carol
sentences.translation: 她现在三岁但是下月就四岁了。

sentences.translation: 我会记下来，因为那是她开始上课的年龄。好的，她对于自己的生日和要来中心这件事显得很兴奋。很高兴听到你这么说。你的地址是什么？

fragments.text: It's 46 Wombat Road, that's Woodside

sentences.speaker: Carol
sentences.translation: 是沃姆巴特路46号，林边。

So, have you decided on the days you'd like to bring your daughter here? I'd prefer Monday and
if possible.

sentences.translation: 那么，你决定你带女儿来这里的日子了吗？如果可能，我希望是周一和周三。

fragments.text: Mmm. I'll check, Monday's fine, but I think the centre is already full for
. Erm. Yes. Sorry. It seems to be a very popular day. We can offer you a
as well.

fragments.text: Oh dear. I suppose Thursday would be all right because she has swimming on Friday.

sentences.speaker: Carol
sentences.translation: 哦天呢。我想周四应该可以，因为周五她要去游泳。

fragments.text: OK, got that. Because a lot of parents work, we do
start and
finish times.

sentences.speaker: Staff
sentences.translation: 好的，明白了。因为很多家长工作，我们提供灵活的开始和结束时间。

fragments.text: We are open from
in the morning until 6 o'clock at night. What time would you like your daughter to start?

sentences.speaker: Staff
sentences.translation: 我们从早晨7:30开业，直到晚上6点。你想你的女儿几点开始？

fragments.text: I need to get to work in the city by
so I'll drop her off at
. You're pretty close to the city here so that should give me plenty of time to get there. That's fine.

sentences.speaker: Carol
sentences.translation: 我需要9:00到城里上班，所以我会8:30把她送到这里。你们这里离城里很近，所以这应该能留给我充足的时间到工作地点。好的。

fragments.text: Now, we also need to decide which group she'll be in. We have
and they're divided up
. There's the green group, which is for three to four year olds. And then there's the red group which is for four to

sentences.translation: 现在，我们还需要确定她参加哪组。我们有两个不同的组，它们是按照年龄划分的。绿队是面向3-4岁的孩子的。红队是面向4-5岁的。

fragments.text: She's quite mature for her age and she can already write her name and read a little. Well, I'll put her in the red group and we can always change her to the green one if there are any problems. That sounds fine.

sentences.speaker: Carol
sentences.translation: 她在她的年龄算比较成熟的，她已经可以写她的名字，并且做一些阅读。那么我就把她放到红队，如果有任何的问题，我们随时可以把她调换到绿队。听起来不错。

fragments.text: OK. Let's move on to meals. We can
lunch and dinner. As she's finishing pretty early, she won't need dinner, will you give her

sentences.translation: 好的。让我们谈谈饮食。我们提供午餐和晚餐。因为她放学比较早，她不需要晚餐，来之前你会给她吃早饭吗？

fragments.text: Yes, she'll only need lunch.

sentences.speaker: Carol
sentences.translation: 是的，她只需要午餐。

fragments.text: Now, does she have any
we need to know about? Does she have asthma or any hearing
for example?

sentences.speaker: Staff
sentences.translation: 有没有我们需要知道的她的身体情况？比如她有没有哮喘或者听力问题？

fragments.text: No. But she does need to
. Oh, I'll make a note of that. Yes, she's pretty good about wearing them, she can't see much without them.

sentences.speaker: Carol
sentences.translation: 没有。但是她的确需要戴眼镜。哦，我要把这个记下来。是的，她对于戴眼镜反应不错，没有眼镜她看不清太多东西。

fragments.text: Right. OK. Now, I also need

of a friend or family member we can

sentences.translation: 你需要哪些信息？只需要一位朋友或家庭成员的名字和电话，以便我们随时联系不到你的时候可以联系。

fragments.text: OK. That'd better be my sister... Jenny Ball. That's B- A- double L. Her phone number is

sentences.translation: 好的。那最好是我的姐姐……詹妮·鲍尔。是B-A-双写L。她的电话是3346 7523。很好。所以她是孩子的姨妈？是的，是这样。我也会记一下。

fragments.text: Now, is there anything you'd like to ask? What about payment? How much are the fees each term? Well, for two days and the hours you've chosen, that will be
altogether.

sentences.translation: 现在，有什么您想问的吗？关于付款？每学期多少钱？嗯，按照您选择的两天和你选的时间段，总共是450元。

fragments.text: OK, and do I have to pay that now? No, we send out invoices once the children start at the centre. You can choose to pay at the end of each term or we do offer a slightly
if you pay every month.

sentences.speaker: Carol
sentences.translation: 好的，我需要现在付款吗？不，孩子一旦来到中心，我们会发送发票。你可以选择在每学期末付款，或者如果你每月支付，我们会提供一点折扣。

fragments.text: Oh. I'll do that then. I find it easier to
that way and I'm not used to the
just yet.

sentences.translation: 哦，那就这么做吧。这样更容易做预算，而且我还不习惯学期日期。

fragments.text: Good, it makes it a lot simpler for us as well. Well, that's everything. Would you like me to show you around...?

sentences.speaker: Staff
sentences.translation: 很好，这对我们也简单多了。好了，都办完了。需要我带你四处看看吗……？
